text:
cheng: Heads up — us-west1 inference tail latency spiking for short-chat requests, started ~10m ago. P95 ~800ms -> P99 ~1.6s. Noticed a cluster churn event around the same time.
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: pool=west-spot-3 eviction_rate=12% (5m), enqueue_depth up 8x, active_requests queuing.
ryan: I’m seeing 502s from runtime on small seq paths, KV cache miss rate jumped after a bunch of instances were terminated. Likely cache warmup + routing fallback thrash.
sam: any net metrics? could be EBS/NFS or cross-AZ bandwidth hitting limits when pods reschedule.
maria: checking — host_net_tx on affected nodes at 95th pct, disk_io_wait up ~40ms. Also noticed a spike in retries from the routing layer.
sre-oncall: Recommendation: short-term mitigation: (A) reduce reliance on west-spot-3 for latency-sensitive routes by preferring on-demand, (B) drop batch_size for chat.short from 4 -> 2, (C) enable local prefix caching for chat.short to avoid KV warmups.
cheng: Agree. Cost tradeoff acknowledged but need availability first. We should also stagger drain windows so not all spot nodes terminate at once.
ryan: How do we flip the route preference quickly?
sam: Two options: control-plane API or patch configmap. Example: 
```
# prefer on-demand for short-chat route
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/routes/chat.short/preferences \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CP_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"prefer_on_demand":true}'

# (k8s config fallback)
kubectl patch cm inference-routing -n platform --type merge -p '{"data":{"chat.short.prefer_on_demand":"true"}}'
```
ryan: OK rolling that now.
deploy-bot: deploy started by ryan — route preference change -> control-plane v2.3.7 (rolling update).
maria: I also pushed a temp autoscaler tweak: scale_up_threshold reduced to 60% for west pools to react faster to burst.
sre-oncall: Good — also set drain_throttle to 30s to avoid simultaneous evictions. That should reduce parallel cache cold starts.
kevin: I’ll open a follow-up to evaluate persistent solution: split short-seq traffic to a dedicated on-demand hotpool and tune placement. Action: KEVIN -> design doc with cost delta.
cheng: After the patch latency started trending down within 90s. P99 is back to ~550ms. Still above baseline but acceptable for now.
ryan: still seeing a few 502s; guessing older in-flight requests timed out during node termination. Increasing gentle drain timeout to 45s might help.
sre-oncall: Done. Updated graceful_termination_seconds=45 on nodegroup config.
maria: Confirming network egress normalized and disk wait reduced. Looks like the combination of fewer evictions + preferring on-demand fixed the amplification.
cheng: Post-mortem items: 1) Dedicated hotpool for chat.short (owner: kevin) 2) Autoscaler tuning per route (owner: maria) 3) Improve eviction signal smoothing and stagger drains (owner: sre-oncall) 4) Add alert for KV cache miss rate to correlate with evictions (owner: ryan).
ryan: I’ll add the KV cache alert and a runbook entry for this exact sequence (evictions -> cache miss -> routing thrash).
kevin: Will start draft for hotpool costing and placement by EOD.
ops-bot: Incident resolved: latency degraded -> mitigation applied -> monitoring shows recovery. Duration ~28m.
cheng: Thanks all — nice quick coordination. Leaving follow-ups in the infra board. :thumbsup:
